newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bourse seen up amid see-saw market.
newsitem.headline: Polish bourse seen up amid see-saw market.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to rise, signalled by the stronger buying after price-fixing that followed Thursday's fall, but analysts were divided on whether the gains would be carried into next week.

Some analysts saw this week's slight fall with gaining and losing sessions alternating as profit-taking before the continuation of last week's 9.3-percent jump, with the market buoyed in part by firms' better July earnings reports.
Others said last week's gains in higher turnovers were an upward correction within the downtrend begun on July 5, when the market hit a 27-month high. - Steven Silber +48 22 653 9700
